task: Pick up the blue ring from the table and put it in the wooden tray
Turn on the white extension cable
Use the spoon to move some of the brown objects to the other bowl
Take the masking tape and move it to the right
Move the sneakers and the books slightly to the left then place the sneaker on the right on the books
Remove the lid
Use the towel to wipe in the white bowl
Move the keys to the left
Remove the glass container from the black lid, put it on the table and then put the black lid on the container
Use the wooden fork to stir the pot and put it back
Pull the zipper closed
Move the eyeglass case to the left
Put the orange, the apple, the yellow container and the strawberry in the plastic
Pick up the mug on the plate and put it on the table
Take one spoon from the cup and place it on the table
Touch the faucet handle then pick up the fork and put it into the dish rack
Put the shirt on the black chair on the brown chair
Remove the green bottle from top fridge door shelf and place it on the middle fridge door shelf
Remove one straw from the open drawer and put it on the countertop, close the open drawer
Put the silver spoon in the blue bowl.
